query: Let `R = (R i)` be a family of monoids and `B = (B i)` a family of submonoids (one in each `R i`), and let `𝓕` be a filter on the index set. An element `x : Πʳ i, [R i, B i]_[𝓕]` is a unit if and only if (i) `x i` is a unit in `R i` for every `i`, and (ii) eventually along `𝓕`, the value `x i` lies in `B i` and is a unit in the submonoid `B i`.
